runs.question: What does the memo require agencies to do within 180 days?

answer.text:
For OMB M-25-21, the 180-day requirement is the compliance plan. Consistent with Section 104(c) and (d) of the AI in Government Act of 2020, within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum or any update to this memorandum, and every two years thereafter until 2036, each agency must submit to 0MB and post publicly on the agency's website either a plan to achieve consistency with this memorandum, or a written determination that the agency does not use and does not anticipate using covered AL

The same passage adds that Agencies must also include plans to update any existing internal AI principles and guidelines to ensure consistency with this memorandum. It also states that 0MB will provide templates for these compliance plans.

The search results did not show any other action in M-25-21 with a 180-day deadline, so I can't say whether there are others beyond these.
